eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lake, IN; at 3:53 PM on AUG 31, 2021 Effective until 2:53 PM SEP 1, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A Statewide Silver Alert has been declared.

The Gary Police Department is investigating the disappearance of Davion Blakes, a 15 year old black male, 5 feet 6 inches tall, 100 pounds, black hair with brown eyes, last seen wearing a T-shirt and blue jeans.

Davion is missing from Gary, Indiana, and was last seen on Tuesday, August 31, 2021 at 3:00 am. He is believed to be in extreme danger and may require medical assistance. 

If you have any information on Davion Blakes, contact the Gary Police Department at 219-660-0000 or 911.

A photo of Davion is available at https://bit.ly/davionblakes again, that's https://bit.ly/davionblakes. Call 219-660-0000 or 911 with information.
